show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Steve Mandel - Investing Behind Change
summary: In our conversation, we discuss how the investing business has evolved since Steve’s start in the 1980s, why it’s so difficult to drive alpha by shorting stocks today versus 20 years ago, and why Steve still loves to get into the guts of a business. Steve shares his lessons through a variety of great stories, which made this such a fun experience. Before we transition to my interview with Steve, I’d also like to highlight the newest Colossus show, Business Breakdowns.
